verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a software-delivered legal services platform, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows a public repository, published source, or open license. The items cover only formation services, pricing, attorney consults and an llms.txt crawler-guidance file, which is not source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
